protocol.guard_rules: One-minute adverse move >=1% or spread >=10bps -> exit; depth <=25% prior median or volume >=3x and adverse signed imbalance >=60% -> halve; no reentry
protocol.freeze_note: Rules fixed before event replay; designed with knowledge of flash-crash mechanism, not blind discovery

source.citation: Menkveld, Hautsch and Voigt (2026), Market Responses to a VIX Shock
source.unit_note: Extraction code establishes signed volume in shares, total volume in USD, spread in bps; dataset card prose has inconsistent unit/window descriptions. Session wall-clock encoded as UTC was preserved as New York time, not shifted.

limitations: Explicit hypothetical pre-existing long position at 13:55; this is not an entry predicted by the daily committee.
Five-second aggregated quotes are not full consolidated tick-by-tick executable fills.
Spread/depth are time-weighted aggregates; estimated execution includes fees, latency and depth caps but not queue position or market impact.
Volume injections alter inputs only; they do not reconstruct how other traders would change prices.
These scenario returns are intraday, never annualized.
Daily committee replay is reported separately; a daily model cannot claim to have forecast a five-minute crash.
